The name "Adelaide" may refer to either **Greater Adelaide** (including the [Adelaide Hills](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_Hills)) or the [Adelaide central business district](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_city_centre); the [demonym](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demonym) _Adelaidean_ is used to denote the city and the residents of Adelaide. The [traditional owners](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Native_title_in_Australia#Traditional_owner) of the Adelaide region are the [Kaurna](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaurna),[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide#cite_note-13) with the name _Tarndanya_ referring to the area of the city centre and surrounding [Park Lands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_Park_Lands), in the [Kaurna language](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaurna_language). [[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide#cite_note-14) Adelaide is situated on the [Adelaide Plains](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_Plains) north of the [Fleurieu Peninsula](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fleurieu_Peninsula), between the [Gulf St Vincent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gulf_St_Vincent) in the west and the [Mount Lofty Ranges](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Lofty_Ranges) in the east. Its metropolitan area encompasses over [430 suburbs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Adelaide_suburbs), extending 96km (60mi) from [Gawler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gawler) in the north to [Sellicks Beach](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sellicks_Beach) in the south and 20km (12mi) from the western coast to the eastern [foothills](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_Hills) of the Mount Lofty Ranges. Named in honour of [Adelaide of Saxe-Meiningen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_of_Saxe-Meiningen), wife of [King William IV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_IV), the city was founded in 1836 as the [planned capital](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_town) for a freely settled British colony in [Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia).[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide#cite_note-15) [Colonel William Light](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Light) designed the city centre in a [grid layout](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grid_plan) with wide boulevards and large public squares, [surrounded by parks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_Park_Lands), now [listed as national heritage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_National_Heritage_List). Today, Adelaide is a popular [travel destination](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tourism_in_Australia) and hosts [many festivals and sporting events](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Organised_events_in_Adelaide), such as the [Adelaide 500](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_500), [Tour Down Under](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tour_Down_Under), [Gather Round](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gather_Round), [LIV Golf Adelaide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LIV_Golf_Adelaide), the [Adelaide International](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_International_(tennis)), the [Adelaide Fringe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_Fringe) and the [Australian MotoGP Grand Prix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_motorcycle_Grand_Prix) from 2027. [[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide#cite_note-17) The city also gave rise to Australia's [automotive industry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Automotive_industry_in_Australia), having also hosted the first [Australian Grand Prix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_Grand_Prix) under the [Formula One](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Formula_One) banner between 1985 and 1995. Adelaide is known for its [food and wine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Australian_wine) industries, its coastline and hills, and defence and manufacturing industries. Adelaide is South Australia's government and commercial centre, with activity concentrated in the city's [central business district](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_central_business_district) along the boulevards of [North Terrace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Terrace,_Adelaide) and [King William Street](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_William_Street,_Adelaide). [[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide#cite_note-18) Adelaide is connected by significant [bus, train and tram networks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transport_in_Adelaide), operated by [Adelaide Metro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_Metro), with its primary railway terminus at the [Adelaide railway station](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adelaide_railway_station). ## Further reading - Buttress, Philip, ed. (2013). "Adelaide". _Adelaide: A literary city_. University of Adelaide Press. ### Adelaide at a glance: Top experiences
- **Don’t miss:** [Adelaide Festival](http://adelaidefestival.com.au/) and [Adelaide Fringe](https://adelaidefringe.com.au/about-us) (February to March)

## Top things to do in Adelaide
[![Person shopping for fresh produce at Adelaide Central Market, South Australia © South Australian Tourism Commission / Matt Nettheim](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/guide-to-adelaide/jcr:content/mainParsys/imagecontainer/imageContainerParsys/imagehighlights_943507582/ImageTile/imageHighlightsSrc.adapt.584.medium.jpg)](https://adelaidecentralmarket.com.au/)

[![People enjoying a wine tasting at Jacob’s Creek in the Barossa Valley, South Australia © John Montesi](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/guide-to-adelaide/jcr:content/mainParsys/imagecontainer/imageContainerParsys/imagehighlights_383236172/ImageTile/imageHighlightsSrc.adapt.584.medium.jpg)](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/best-wine-regions.html)

South Australia is the country’s wine capital, and many of its [best wineries](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/best-wine-regions.html) are just a short drive from Adelaide.

[![Aerial view of the mangroves and turquoise waterways of Garden Island, South Australia © Michael Waterhouse](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/guide-to-adelaide/jcr:content/mainParsys/imagecontainer/imageContainerParsys/imagehighlights_6057/ImageTile/imageHighlightsSrc.adapt.584.medium.jpg)](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/hidden-gems.html)

[![People viewing artworks at the Art Gallery of South Australia, Adelaide, South Australia © South Australian Tourism Commission](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/guide-to-adelaide/jcr:content/mainParsys/imagecontainer/imageContainerParsys/imagehighlights_597213169/ImageTile/imageHighlightsSrc.adapt.584.medium.jpg)](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/best-museums-art-galleries-and-theatres.html)

Adelaide loves to party, boasting a calendar packed with exciting festivals and city-wide celebrations. Music festivals, culinary showcases, sporting events and more – you can’t help but join in.

Home to 2,500 animals, [Adelaide Zoo](https://www.adelaidezoo.com.au/) is all-day entertainment for all ages, with experiences like getting up close with tree kangaroos and koala meet and greets.

[![Person walking along a path through lush foliage in the Adelaide Botanic Garden, South Australia © Tourism Australia](https://www.australia.com/content/australia/en_us/places/adelaide-and-surrounds/guide-to-adelaide/jcr:content/mainParsys/imagecontainer/imageContainerParsys/imagehighlights_15620644/ImageTile/imageHighlightsSrc.adapt.584.medium.jpg)](https://www.botanicgardens.sa.gov.au/visit/adelaide-botanic-garden)

# **Adelaide**
## Adelaide — a place where the smaller moments take centre stage.
Adelaide is a place where quality takes precedence over quantity. A place that goes beyond just towering buildings and glass windows that reflect dozens of commuters coming and going. Here, we value the smaller moments – because we know that’s what makes a place. Like the passionate [restaurant](https://southaustralia.com/guides/best-restaurants-in-adelaide) owner who greets you as they weave through tables; the art student, curled up in the corner of a [gallery](https://southaustralia.com/products/adelaide/attraction/art-gallery-of-south-australia), furiously sketching; how the air feels cooler the minute you step beneath the canopy of the [botanic gardens](https://southaustralia.com/products/adelaide/attraction/adelaide-botanic-garden), or feeling united by a [festival crowd](https://southaustralia.com/guides/the-south-australian-festivals-and-events-calendar). Experiences in Adelaide are abundant — offering exactly what you need, right when you need it.

## **Start planning your trip to Adelaide**
### You’re here to soak it all in, not just tick off a list. Forgo the jam-packed itinerary and let yourself be. Scroll through our curated guides and plan a visit that leaves you feeling renewed — not burnt out.

## **Adelaide Experiences and Attractions**
### Explore the city with experiences that matter most to you. Let the breeze rush through your hair as you stand on the edge of Adelaide Oval’s roof, swap stories with the local cheesemonger at the markets and share a laugh with the bartender as he shakes up your cocktail. Discover the spots we think will make it to your highlights reel.

## ADELAIDE
The Adelaide metropolitan area is not covered by a regional tourism organisation. Key local councils have their own tourism staff and the SATC liaises with them. The State Government’s Vibrant City initiative includes a strong tourism focus and brings together key agencies and the City of Adelaide.

To find out more about Adelaide, download the visitor guide, drop into a visitor information centre or use the contact details below.

## ADELAIDE, AUSTRALIA (2026) | 12 Best Things To Do In & Around Adelaide (+ Travel Tips)
Adelaide is the vibrant capital of South Australia and is located on the picturesque shores of the Saint Vincent Gulf. Known as the "20-minute city," its compact design allows for easy exploration. Adelaide distinguishes itself through its elegant architecture, expansive parklands, and a renowned food and wine scene.
